Draft a coordination message to United Airlines asking whether my MileagePlus Gold upgrade request has been applied to flight UA 2310 on June 3, 2026, referencing my recent travel-medical coordination and emphasizing the urgency due to upcoming schedule constraints connected to the Chicago conference logistics.
answer:

Hello United Airlines Customer Care,

Could you please confirm whether my MileagePlus Gold upgrade request has been applied to flight UA 2310 on June 3, 2026?

I’m coordinating time-sensitive logistics for an upcoming Chicago conference, and my schedule has limited flexibility. I would appreciate confirmation of the request’s current status, including whether it is pending, waitlisted, or confirmed, and whether any action is needed from me.

Passenger name: [Your full name]
MileagePlus number: [Your number]
Confirmation number: [Your reservation code]

Thank you for your prompt assistance.

Best,
Alice
